title: Bain: private equity outlook 2026
method: Industry synthesis using transaction and fund datasets.
limitations: Announced transactions can be pending. Disclosed deal values are not fund cash distributions; provider coverage and definitions differ.

title: Bain: welcome to a new era in private equity
method: Industry analysis and illustrative buyout model.
limitations: The 5% versus 10–12% EBITDA-growth comparison depends on different financing and valuation assumptions; it is not an empirical hurdle for every deal.

title: Jefferies: 2025 global secondary market review
method: Adviser estimates of secondary transactions and pricing.
limitations: Selected market coverage. NAV is a reported valuation reference, not independently verified intrinsic value. LP and GP transactions are distinct.

title: ILPA: NAV-based facilities guidance
limitations: Governance guidance, not a universal legal obligation or a measured prevalence estimate.

title: ILPA: continuation-fund guidance
limitations: Transaction circumstances differ; recommendations do not establish that a particular price or process is fair.

title: ILPA: draft updated continuation-vehicle guidance
limitations: Still described as draft on the checked page. This report does not treat draft provisions as final requirements.

title: Nucor: completion of C.H.I. acquisition
limitations: Establishes purchase consideration, not sponsor net returns or the causes of operating improvement.

title: KKR: Q2 2022 earnings-call transcript
limitations: Selected successful investment. Reported 10× money multiple is not an LP net IRR or a typical buyout outcome.

title: Medline: Q1 2026 Form 10-Q, Note 1
method: Regulatory filing; December 2025 IPO proceeds reconciliation.
limitations: Includes full underwriter option. Net proceeds are after underwriting discounts but before other offering expenses. Pre-IPO owners are broader than one PE fund.

title: Davis et al.: heterogeneous effects of PE buyouts
method: Academic research using firm and establishment data.
limitations: Historical US buyouts; outcomes vary by deal type, sponsor and economic conditions. It does not estimate AI-era returns.

title: Bain: Global Private Equity Report 2026, full report
method: Full report supporting aggregate exit value.
limitations: Same underlying research as sources 1–2, not independent corroboration; announced exit value includes debt where relevant.
